title: HistCorp — Historical Corpora and Tools (fornsvenska / Fornsvenska textbanken)
notes: HistCorp is an open platform for historical corpora and tools, distributed via the Swedish CLARIN node. Its Swedish section draws on Fornsvenska textbanken (machine-readable Old and Early Modern Swedish texts 1350-1758), all supplied as plain text. The source site (project2.sol.lu.se/fornsvenska) no longer resolves; the texts are available through the HistCorp Swedish download (Zenodo). The 5.6 M words exceed Fornsvenska's 44 texts and 1.4 M tokens, so the entry includes other HistCorp Swedish corpora; the texts counted here come from this download bundle. Freely available; the licence is CC BY. Related searchable corpora are offered by Språkbanken Text's Korp ('all_hist' mode). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Eva Pettersson (Uppsala University) & Beata Megyesi (Stockholm University), Swedish CLARIN
license_note: The Zenodo record 'The HistCorp Collection of Historical Corpora and Resources - Part III' (28 ZIP files; published 9 March 2018) is licensed CC BY 4.0; individual source corpora inside may have their own conditions.
